_comment: HELD-OUT TEST set. Write these queries WITHOUT looking at the search heuristics in src/api/server.py, and never tune the pipeline to make a specific case here pass — that turns it into a second dev set. Aim for 15-20 varied queries (objects, actions, spoken phrases, brand/model names, multi-attribute descriptions), ideally including a second, unrelated library. Same format as search_labels.json: {"q": ..., "expect_top": name} or {"q": ..., "expect_in": [names]}.
